user_statements: Train a Remaining Useful Life (RUL) predictor for C-MAPSS turbofan engine SCADA logs.
It is a zip file containing CSVs of SCADA sensor readings. I am a Data Scientist. We need high accuracy, but basic feature importance is preferred.
It is the C-MAPSS dataset. The features are 21 sensor channels and 3 operational settings. The target is the RUL in cycles. The industry is Aerospace.
